analysis.ja: 本日の観測では自サービス (kotoba.cloud / api.murakumo.cloud) の DNS 応答に変化はなく、Cloudflare 前提の address が確認された。KEV feed は CVE-2021-21985 (VMware vCenter Server の入力値検証不備) を含む 2021-11-03 追加分が優先表示されており、vCenter を運用する場合は公開版カタログの確認と優先パッチを推奨する。断定的な悪用状況の主張は避け、出典 URL を参照のこと。出典: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
analysis.en: No DNS changes were observed for our services (kotoba.cloud / api.murakumo.cloud); Cloudflare-fronted addresses were confirmed as expected. The KEV feed surfaced the 2021-11-03 batch including CVE-2021-21985 (VMware vCenter Server improper input validation); operators running vCenter should check the published catalog and prioritize patching accordingly. We avoid asserting active exploitation and refer to the source URL. Source: https://www.cisa.gov/known-exploited-vulnerabilities-catalog
